ready1_open_rewrite.raw_question_text: As shown in the figure, it is known that $AB\parallel CD\parallel EF$, $AD:DF=2:3$, $BE=15$, what is the length of $BC$?
ready1_open_rewrite.raw_answer_text:
\textbf{Solution:} Since $AB \parallel CD \parallel EF$, \\
it follows that $\frac{BC}{BE} = \frac{AD}{AF}$, \\
which means $\frac{BC}{15} = \frac{2}{2+3}$, \\
hence, BC$=\boxed{6}$.
